notes: A209860.A209862_conjecture (A209860_mathlib.lean). Grouped with A209860/A209861/A209862 (main directory OEIS/A209860). A209642 = entry's Scheme loop; A209861 n = ncard {i | A209642 i < A209642 n} (position in A209641 = ascending values); A209862 = invFun A209861 (bijection proved); A054429 n = 3*2^log2 n - 1 - n; statements for n >= 1. Key idea: closed form A209642(n) + 2^E = 2^(2 len) + tau(n), E = 2 len - pop, 2 tau < 2^E; on a level, values are ordered by popcount then by tau (odd beats even, else recurse on n div 2), and A054429 (flip all bits below the leading one) reverses both, so ranks map r -> 2^(L-1)-1-r. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: the reading that A209641 is exactly the ascending list of A209642 values (entry statement; certificate/check.py compares with the entry's membership test below 4^8).
